# Dataset fixtures

These are tiny synthetic records authored for OrchidRec's tests. They use the
publicly documented MovieLens delimiter layouts, but they are not rows copied
from a MovieLens distribution and do not include titles, demographics, or any
other third-party data.

`recbole-inter/synthetic.inter` is a separately authored synthetic RecBole
interaction-format fixture. Its `001` and `1` user tokens are intentionally
distinct; no rows or identifiers originate from an external dataset.
